purpose: Research evidence for the reference-viewing library; not a runtime benchmark manifest.

policy.unknown_values: null or an explicit unknown string; never infer real-time playback from FPS or browser playback rate

candidates.title: My Basketball Workout During The Off-Season
candidates.publication_evidence: Expanded video description in the browser
candidates.source_provenance: Curry's own channel and collaboration publisher; description identifies trainer Brandon Payne
observed_views: oblique; camera-relative orientation changes across chapters

inspection_points.observation: Shooting foundation chapter begins; wide court view, Curry and several other people visible head to feet.
Lateral movement shooting chapter begins; Curry is on the right, facing toward the left hoop; full body visible in the wide view.
Curry moves with the ball at the right of the frame; several larger foreground people can distract subject selection.
Camera framing has changed; subtitles and editorial text are present. This is not a calibrated fixed side camera.

limitations: Drill movement differs from a stationary catch-and-shoot benchmark
Multiple people require explicit Curry identity and subject selection
Edited instructional video; whole-clip continuity is unverified

candidates.title: That Time Stephen Curry Hit 105 THREES IN A ROW 🤯
candidates.publication_evidence: Indexed official video page; publication date is not recording date

inspection_points.observation: Curry is visible head to feet in portrait footage presented within blurred landscape side padding; hoop and ball are visible.

limitations: Rear projection can hide the shooting elbow and wrist behind the torso
Portrait padding must not be interpreted as the native camera geometry
Other uploads of the 105-shot run may contain duplicate shots
No full-shot interval has been annotated

candidates.title: Steph Curry Shows The World Why He’s The Greatest Shooter Ever! 🔥
candidates.publication_evidence: Channel and title verified in browser; exact publication date not recorded
candidates.source_provenance: Verified Josh Englert channel; original upload linked by the Bilibili derivatives below

inspection_points.observation: Full-body dribbling setup in front-oblique view, with other players nearby.
Rear shooting follow-through close-up; legs and feet outside the frame.
Side-oblique close view; lower legs outside the frame and a large foreground person partially obstructs the scene.

limitations: Camera framing and orientation vary
Full-body visibility in one sample does not establish visibility through an entire shot
Multiple people and cropped close-ups require rejecting or selecting individual windows

Only 360p playback was inspected; this is not a claim about the highest available source resolution
